news.headline: CERT.br alert — Grandoreiro banking trojan resurgence targeting Brazilian financial apps
news.detail: CERT.br issued an urgent alert on the resurgence of Grandoreiro banking trojan, a modular remote-access trojan specifically targeting Brazilian financial institution customers. New variant (Grandoreiro v7) evades current AV signatures and targets mobile banking apps via overlay attacks. Distributed via phishing campaigns impersonating Receita Federal (tax authority) and major Brazilian banks. Over 900 Brazilian financial institutions and 1,500 banks in 60 countries previously targeted. FEBRABAN has issued a parallel alert to member banks.

news.headline: Mexico CGCYBER elevates critical infrastructure cyber threat level to HIGH
news.detail: Mexico's Cyber Defence Command (CGCYBER) elevated the cyber threat level for critical financial infrastructure to HIGH following confirmed intrusion attempts against two major Mexican banks and the SPEI interbank payment system. CGCYBER attributes the campaign to a threat actor with state-level capabilities. CNBV and Banco de Mexico issued emergency security directives to all supervised financial institutions. SPEI transaction monitoring enhanced; anomaly detection thresholds lowered. Firms with Mexican correspondent banking relationships should review access controls.

news.headline: ANPD fines fintech R$7.2M — LGPD breach notification failure and inadequate controls
news.detail: Brazil's ANPD imposed a R$7.2 million fine on a licensed fintech for two violations: (1) failure to notify ANPD and affected data subjects within 72 hours of a data breach as required by LGPD Article 48; (2) absence of adequate technical and administrative security measures under LGPD Article 46. The breach exposed 2.1 million customer financial records including CPF numbers, account balances, and transaction histories. ANPD has signalled further enforcement actions targeting financial sector in H2 2026.

news.headline: Colombia CSIRT — phishing surge targeting Bancolombia and Davivienda customers
news.detail: Colombia's national CSIRT issued an alert on a coordinated phishing campaign targeting customers of major Colombian banks using convincing cloned portals. Campaign uses SMS smishing and WhatsApp lures impersonating bank security alerts. Over 45,000 attempted credential thefts recorded in July 2026. SFC (Superintendencia Financiera) has instructed all supervised entities to enhance anti-phishing monitoring and customer communications. GAFILAT cybercrime coordination group notified given cross-border infrastructure.

news.headline: GAFILAT advisory — crypto-based financial cybercrime schemes proliferating across LatAm
news.detail: GAFILAT issued a regional advisory on the proliferation of crypto-based financial cybercrime schemes across Latin America, specifically pig-butchering scams (SHA ZHU PAN), DeFi rug-pulls targeting retail investors, and crypto exchange hacks exploiting weak wallet key management. Advisory notes: five GAFILAT member jurisdictions recorded significant crypto-related cyber losses in H1 2026. Financial institutions with crypto exposure must implement enhanced transaction monitoring for typologies outlined in GAFILAT Guidance Note 15/2026.
